mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in retail sales signals a weakening consumer sector that will drag on corporate earnings and equity prices, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An accelerating industrial production index signals strengthening economic activity that will boost corporate earnings and equity prices, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of months following an INDPRO acceleration.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate signals a weakening labor market that will drag on consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A flattening yield curve (10Y-2Y spread) signals a tightening financial conditions that will compress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 returns, especially if accompanied by an inverted curve.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of months following a yield curve inversion.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts signals a strengthening residential investment sector that will boost economic activity and equity prices, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in payroll employment signals a weakening labor market that will drag on consumer spending and equity prices, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 70% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the ISM manufacturing index signals a weakening industrial sector that will drag on economic activity and equity prices, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of months following an ISM sub-45 reading.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the consumer price index signals rising inflation expectations that will boost real yields and compress equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances.
